bhaṅga.cp: masc. breaking up; dissolution. (nt.), the humped cloth.
bhaṅga.p: [Bhanja+a] (pu,na) Google Translate Bidi + A. ဒါန်၊ ထီ. 291, 662. Bhizanam Bengal. Vibhavini. 138.] (Pu) (1) (a) Damage; Disappearance. (B) Disappearing. Ben (2) Waves. (N) (3) Yarn. (4) Yarn. (5) Yarn mixed with five kinds of yarn. Weaving a combination of five kinds of yarn, starting with the six yarns - cloth - robe, Bang Chi - Clothes - Robe. (7) Laundry - Clothes - Robe. (8) Criticism - Divided into two parts. Bengal: Look. (B) Broken. Bengal: See.

bhaṅga：bhaṅga（pu，na）
ဘင်္ဂ（ပု၊န）
[bhanja+a．bhidi+a．，ṭī．291，662．bhañjanaṃ bhaṅgo．vibhāvinī．138．]
[ဘန္ဇ+အ။ ဘိဒိ+အ။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၂၉၁၊ ၆၆၂။ ဘဉ္ဇနံ ဘငေ်္ဂါ။ ဝိဘာဝိနီ။ ၁၃၈။]
C: bhaṅga：[m．] breaking up; dissolution．（nt．），the humped cloth．
P: Bhaṅga，2 （nt．） [cp．Class．Sk．bhaṅga，fr．bhañj： see bhañjati] 1．（lit．） breaking，breaking off，in sākhā° a layer of broken-off branches J．III，407．-- 2．（fig．） breaking up，dissolution，disruption （see on form Cpd．25，66） Ps．I，57 sq．（°ânupassanā insight into disruption），quoted & expld at Vism．640 sq．; VbhA．27 （°khaṇa）; Sdhp．48，78 （āsā°）．Cp．vi°．（Page 496）

Bhaṅga，<sup>1</sup> （nt．） [cp．Sk．bhaṅga，which occurs already Atharva-veda XI．6．15 （see Zimmer．Altind．Leben 68），also Av．baṁha，Polish pienka hemp．On its possible etym．connection with Vedic śaṇa （Ath．Veda II．4．5） =P．saṇa & sāṇa hemp （=Gr．kάnnabis，Ger．hanf，E．hemp） see Walde，Lat．Wtb．s．v．cannabis] hemp; coarse hempen cloth Vin．I，58 （where comb<sup>d</sup> with sāṇa）．（Page 496）

လျှော်ချည်။ ဘင်ချည်။ လျှော်ချည်သင်္ကန်း။

bhaṅga：ဘင်္ဂ （ပ） （√ဘဉ္ဇ်+ဏ）
ပျက်စီးခြင်း။ ကျိုးပဲ့ခြင်း။
DOP: 1 bhaṅga m. [ ts ], 1. a break or breach; disruption; breaking, splitting; breaking up, dissolution; Abh 1130 (~o bhede); Vin I 46, 30 (caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ mā majjhe ~o ahosī ti; Sp 979, 14 : samaṃ katvā saṅgharitassa hi majjhe ~o hoti, tato niccaṃ bhijjamānaṃ dubbalaṃ hoti); II 108, 19 (sarakuttiṃ pi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa ~o hoti; Sp 1202, 6 foll.: aladdhaṃ samādhiṃ uppādetuṃ na sakkoti laddhaṃ samāpajjituṃ) = A III 251, 7 (Mp III 326, 20 : samathavipassanācittassa vināso hoti); Ja V 7, 25´ (viddhaṃsanan ti ~aṃ); VI 175, 30* (brahmacariyassa ce ~o hoti); Nidd I 43, 3* (nibbattānaṃ ca dhammānaṃ ~o nesaṃ purakkhato) = Vism 625, 9* ; Nidd I 43, 6* (adassanato āyanti ~ā gacchanty adassanaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce adassanāto; Ee wr gacchanti dassanaṃ; Nidd-a I 152, 17 : bhedā ~ato uddhaṃ adassanabhāvaṃ gacchanti) = Vism 625, 11* ( eds bhaggā); Paṭis I 57, 31 (tassa cittassa ~aṃ anupassati); Vism 630, 13 (nāmarūpassa … vipariṇāmalakkhaṇaṃ khayaṃ ~aṃ vayo ti samanupassati); Sv 506, 11 (khayo ti ādi sabbaṃ ~assa vevacanaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr bhavaṅgassa); Spk II 266, 14* (uppādo jāti akkhāto ~o vutto vayo ti ca); Paṭis-a 635, 19 (uppajjitvā ~aṃ patvā niruddhaṃ atītarūpaṃ); Vibh-a 7, 27 (tayo hi rūpassa khaṇā uppādo ṭhiti ~o ti); — 2. a piece broken off, a morsel; — ifc see uttari-, sākhā-; — see also uttuṅgataraṅgabhaṅga ( sv uttuṅga ).
